claims: No. 1 seed South Carolina defeated No. 3 TCU 78-52 on March 30, 2026.
South Carolina advanced to their sixth consecutive Final Four.
Joyce Edwards scored 24 points for South Carolina.
Joyce Edwards had 12 rebounds for South Carolina.
South Carolina outscored TCU 29-11 in the fourth quarter.
South Carolina faces UConn in the Final Four.
Agot Makeer scored 18 points for South Carolina.
Olivia Miles scored 18 points for TCU.
Olivia Miles had 6 assists for TCU.
The 2026 Final Four is in Phoenix.
South Carolina plays UConn on April 3.
South Carolina won their Elite Eight matchup by 26 points.
South Carolina led 49-41 going into the fourth quarter.
Marta Suarez scored 9 points on 4-for-17 shooting for TCU.
Dawn Staley is the coach of the South Carolina Gamecocks
